Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs. This E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EDaily routine:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHe is a farmer by occupation.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EResident of Miryalagudem\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EStopped working 2 years ago due to right femur fracture and old age.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EWakes up at around 7:00 am in the morning. Eats breakfast by 8:00 am. Goes to his farm and monitors work. Then comes back to his house in the afternoon and has lunch by 1:00 pm. Sleeps for a while in the afternoon\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHe has a cup of tea in the evening at around 5:00 pm , watches TV for a while and has dinner at around 8:00 pm and goes to bed at around 9:30 pm.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EChief complaints:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was brought to casualty with c\/o shortness of breath Grade III MMRC since 20 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHOPI\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 year ago when he developed\u0026nbsp; chest pain and SOB Grade III and went to a hospital in Hyderabad\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPresently- on 9\/7\/23\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E20 days back he developed Shortness of breath Insidious in onset , initially Grade I and gradually progressed to Grade-III.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt was associated with Right sided chest pain , non radiating , pricking type of pain\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt was also associated with PND, dry cough and sweating\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo c\/o orthopnea, palpitations and giddiness\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient also C\/o B\/L lower limbs swelling since 5-6 months, pitting type, extending upto the knee, aggravated on sitting, standing and walking and relieved on lying down.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient also complains of decreased urine output and facial puffiness since 3 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe also complains of constipation- passes stools every 3-4 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe also has distended abdomen since 3 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo c\/o pain abdomen, vomitings, fever, cough, cold\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPAST HISTORY -\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is k\/c\/o DM 2 since 5 years and is on regular medication - Tab. Metformin 500 mg BD\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is also a k\/c\/o Hypertension since 5 years and is on regular medication - Tab. Metoprolol 25 mg + Tab. Amlodipine 5mg OD\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o CAD 1 year ago - underwent Percutaneous Transluminal Coronary Angioplasty with 3 stents- done along with Tab.
